A '''splitter plate'''<ref name="SWS" /> or '''cooling plate''',<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> was a component of [[Quadex/Legends|Quadex's]] [[Kyromaster ion engine/Legends|Kyromaster]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. The splitter plate was designed to dissipate engine and exhaust heat in tandem with four [[Intake|cooling vents]].<ref name="SWS" />
